cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Alpha-tested and Alpha-to-Coverage foliage, pine needles, grass blades, hair cards, and chain-link fences in UE5, Unity, and Three.js
Preventing distant trees and bushes from thinning out or vanishing completely when mipmapping averages α below τ = 0.50
Baking coverage-preserving alpha mipmaps offline or scaling shader alpha by 1 + k·mipLevel at runtime
Pairing with MSAA Alpha-to-Coverage or R2 blue-noise dither stippling (Round 44) for order-independent foliage
not_for: Standard premultiplied alpha blending (OVER operator) where mean opacity ᾱ rather than thresholded coverage is the conserved quantity
Opaque solid meshes with α ≡ 1.0 everywhere
Neural texture super-resolution or generative foliage hallucination
